in_sanskrit.name: Andalika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, Beautiful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Andalika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Andalika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words an (meaning 'peace') and dala (meaning 'grace' or 'beauty'). This name is often given to girls in Hindu tradition who are believed to bring peace and beauty into the world.
